notes: UI/UX screen-design skill (SDLC Stage 3a). Evaluate by checking it runs design intelligence (design-system) first, produces ASCII wireframes with UI-library components from PROJECT.md, i18n keys, role-based visibility, and loading/empty/error states, and writes docs/specs/requirements/SCREEN-[feature].md; positives should fire, the API-design boundary should route to design-function.

evals.prompt: Design the UI screens and wireframes for the order management feature.
evals.expected_output: Detects the UI library from PROJECT.md/CLAUDE.md, runs design-system design intelligence (style/color/typography), sketches ASCII wireframes per screen with correct library components, specifies role-based visibility, i18n keys, and loading/empty/error states, and writes docs/specs/requirements/SCREEN-order-management.md. Avoids AI anti-patterns (bento, aurora, neon, emoji icons).

evals.prompt: Create the wireframes and component layout spec for the user profile page.
evals.expected_output: Produces ASCII wireframes, component hierarchy using the project's UI library, responsive breakpoints (mobile 375px), design tokens table, and i18n keys, saved to docs/specs/requirements/SCREEN-user-profile.md. Does not write frontend code.

evals.prompt: Design the REST API endpoints and request/response DTOs for order management.
evals.expected_output: Should route to design-function / not fire, because this is backend API + DTO design (TECH spec), not UI screen/wireframe design.
